text:
Alex Rivera: Heads up — starting private/VPC rollout for model-routing v2. I saw control plane config updates take >30s to reach ap-southeast edge clusters. Any visibility?
Priya Nair: seeing the same in prod-metrics. propagation histogram shows tail at ~45s. not sure if it’s API server batching or the airgap packaging job.
Miguel Soto: for a couple of customers on air-gapped packages we add a signed artifact bundle that needs manual thumbprint verify. that adds latency; could be the culprit for those clusters.
Samir Patel: we should avoid opaque failures in rollouts. proposal: add a checkpointing watermark per-cluster — config_version desired vs applied. if applied lag > threshold, circuit the traffic split for that cluster back to old variant.
Priya Nair: +1. also need a soft-fail mode for A/B experiments so global split is respected across clusters. right now splits are applied per-controlplane apply, so drift happens during staggered rollouts.
Alex Rivera: console UX question — can we show per-tenant per-cluster rollout progress and a simple "drift" indicator? customers keep asking why 10% still hitting old model even after rollout says 100%.
Miguel Soto: we already export metrics: `desired_config_version` and `applied_config_version`. we can derive drift with a gauge: `config_apply_lag_seconds` and an alert if > 20s. needs tagging by `tenant_id` + `cluster_id`.
Samir Patel: here's a guard logic sketch:
``
if applied_version != desired_version and apply_age > 20s:
  revert_cluster_traffic(cluster_id)
  mark_runbook('restart-controlplane-sync')
```
keep it conservative: only revert cluster-level traffic, not global.
Priya Nair: we also need to surface in the rollout API an `ack_deadline` that the private control plane must report — otherwise console shows stuck and user panics. default 60s for hosted, 300s for air-gapped.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for routing:v2 to 5% traffic (global), canary_slices: ['tenant:alpha']
ops-bot: alert: control-plane sync lag >45s for cluster vpc-33, tenant alpha
Alex Rivera: ok action items: (1) Miguel add `config_apply_lag_seconds` metric + tenant/cluster tags, (2) Samir implement cluster-level revert flow and add config for thresholds, (3) Priya add `ack_deadline` to rollout API and console UX to show per-cluster status. I'll create tickets. :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: thanks — will add notes re: audit log for A/B split changes, we need immutable audit entries per-change.
Miguel Soto: quick win: ship metric + grafana panel today, we can then gate the revert behavior behind a feature flag.
Samir Patel: I’ll prototype the revert flow in the staging canary this afternoon and ping here.
Alex Rivera: sweet. if any cluster recovers, we should auto-reinstate traffic after applied_version == desired_version for 2 consecutive probes.
Priya Nair: agreed. closing loop once dashboards + alerts are in place. :rocket:
